description: This file defines the MockThermostat class, a mock implementation of a Zigbee thermostat device with capabilities for battery status, temperature control, and fan control, used for testing or simulation purposes.

classes.name: MockThermostat
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee thermostat device with capabilities for temperature control, fan control, and battery status.

methods.name: MockThermostat
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock thermostat with specified name, EUI64, and endpoint ID, setting up clusters.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Checks if the device has a low battery status.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status of the device.

methods.name: getHeatSetpoint
methods.description: Gets the current heating temperature setpoint.

methods.name: getCoolSetpoint
methods.description: Gets the current cooling temperature setpoint.

methods.name: getHoldOn
methods.description: Checks if hold mode is active.
